items.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
items.content: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

items.title: ECB seeks industry partners for tokenized deposits, securities experiments
items.content: Industry groups have until Dec. 11 to apply for the ECB’s first experimental exercises under its Appia initiative, with later submissions reviewed on a rolling basis.

items.title: US lawmakers propose up to 30% rewards for prediction market whistleblowers
items.content: Whistleblowers could receive 10% to 30% of monetary sanctions in qualifying prediction market fraud cases exceeding $1 million in penalties.

items.title: Hong Kong pushes to bring crypto custodians, advisers under licensing rules
items.content: Hong Kong’s securities regulator says the proposal would strengthen investor protections, with the bill set for its first reading in the Legislative Council on Dec. 2.

items.title: Wrapped Monero token crashes 99.8% amid suspected $13.5M exploit
items.content: Bitquery traced $13.5 million in suspicious sales of the wrapped Monero token, as its operator blamed a security breach and promised to reimburse affected traders.

items.title: Sky Protocol sees $2 billion in stablecoin withdrawals, disputes illicit fund claims
items.content: Sky says its USDS stablecoin held its $1 value despite more than $2 billion in withdrawals, as it disputes a report linking the protocol to illicit activity.

items.title: Bitcoin falls below $60K for first time since July amid broader market selloff
items.content: Bitcoin fell nearly 6% as US stocks declined, with the Nasdaq dropping more than 2% and Anthropic shares losing almost 10%.

items.title: US Senate advances prediction market restrictions with DEATH BETS Act
items.content: The Senate-approved bill would ban prediction market contracts tied to war, assassination and death amid concerns over potential insider trading on military events.

items.title: Bitcoin price drops to $60K as Anthropic drops to $87 in tech sell-off
items.content: Bitcoin price strength felt pressure from falling US equities as traders reassessed AI prospects after Anthropic’s IPO.

items.title: DBS bets it can lose the deposit and keep the client
items.content: The Singapore bank earned a record $208 million in transaction services fees in the third quarter — now it’s helping companies turn deposits into stablecoins they can spend without it.

items.title: Lagarde warns Europe could miss chance to unify tokenized markets
items.content: The ECB president said Europe’s market for tokenized securities could split into platforms that cannot settle trades with one another.

items.title: Binance hacker moves nearly $600M in ETH, routes funds through THORChain, Chainflip
items.content: OnChain Lens tracked nearly $600 million in ETH transfers over two days as the Binance hackers moved the stolen funds through fresh wallets and cross-chain protocols to obscure their trail.

items.title: VanEck to end Gemini ETF custody deals, keeps Coinbase
items.content: VanEck plans to end Gemini’s custody agreements for three crypto ETFs in February 2027, while Coinbase will continue serving as a custodian for the funds.

items.title: Bitcoin nears repeat of chart pattern that preceded 2023’s $25K retest
items.content: Bitcoin’s 21-day moving average fell below its 200-day average, and analyst Keith Alan expects a second bearish crossover by Sunday.

items.title: BlackRock’s IBIT loses record $541M amid Anthropic market debut
items.content: BlackRock’s IBIT posted its largest daily outflow on record, taking three-session outflows near $900 million as BTC dipped amid a broader market selloff.

items.title: SEC charges 8 firms over fake crypto platforms tied to $37M fraud
items.content: The SEC says the operators showed investors fake certificates and pointed them to filings on the agency’s website as proof of regulatory approval.

items.title: Anthropic’s $81B IPO draws half the net retail buying of SpaceX’s
items.content: Retail investors traded $772 million in Anthropic shares on Thursday, the most Vanda Research has recorded for a market debut since 2012.

items.title: Institutions pile back into US Bitcoin ETFs in Q3 after selling streak
items.content: Asset managers added the equivalent of 49,229 Bitcoin to their US Bitcoin ETF holdings in the third quarter, reversing three quarters of net selling.

items.title: Ledger CTO Charles Guillemet to leave after nine years at company
items.content: Guillemet helped establish Ledger’s Donjon security lab and says his departure has been planned for months.

items.title: Binance’s $6.5B freeze order, Hong Kong ‘suspicious’ of HYPE: Asia Express
items.content: Binance obtains court orders freezing assets stolen in October’s hack. Hong Kong warns citizens about Hyperliquid, and Thai police arrest four foreigners linked to a crypto scam.

items.title: MoonPay seeks US bank charter for stablecoin, custody services
items.content: MoonPay’s proposed national trust bank would offer stablecoin issuance and redemption, reserve management and digital asset custody under federal oversight.

items.title: Hyperliquid Anthropic futures priced within 1% of Nasdaq opening price
items.content: Hyperliquid traders priced Anthropic futures within 1% of the stock’s Nasdaq opening price, as trading surged ahead of the AI company’s IPO.

items.title: Trump’s SEC nominee Johnson backs formal rulemaking for tokenized stock trading
items.content: Former CFTC Commissioner and Democrat Kristin Johnson and ex-SEC aide Steven Levine appeared before lawmakers Thursday.

items.title: Ethereum’s Glamsterdam upgrade could slip to May 2027 over compatibility concerns
items.content: Ethereum developers are weighing changes to gas pricing proposals that could disrupt existing smart contracts, after contacting at least 50 affected companies.

items.title: Why higher rates could slow Bitcoin buying at treasury firms
items.content: A treasury company can have years of dividends covered and still struggle to sell new shares on terms that make another Bitcoin purchase worthwhile.

items.title: Bitcoin price ignores Anthropic debut as ANT share price dips below $100
items.content: Bitcoin dropped toward a third retest of $62,000 as Anthropic debuted on the Nasdaq, hitting highs of $115 per share before dropping below $100.

items.title: Anthropic shares open at $111.50, 34.3% above $83 IPO price
items.content: The Claude chatbot maker began trading under the ticker ANT, with the company’s valuation at around $2 trillion at the opening price.

items.title: Ethereum’s new DeFi security tool raises questions over censorship
items.content: Phylax’s system lets decentralized protocols block potentially harmful transactions, but raises questions about potential censorship and Ethereum’s concentrated builder market.

items.title: Hong Kong adds Hyperliquid to list of ‘suspicious’ crypto platforms
items.content: Hong Kong’s securities regulator said Hyperliquid has no local license and may have promoted its trading services to investors in the city.

items.title: GTA VI publisher racks up nearly 3x Nvidia’s tokenized stock volume
items.content: Tokenized Take-Two shares drew $249.5 million in DEX volume Wednesday, nearly three times the $88.1 million for tokenized Nvidia shares.
